scope: E-013 structured logs, OTel, metrics, SLO, alerts, dashboards, Runbooks and cost baseline

assertions: request body preferred-name-like synthetic content is absent from every OrdinaryLogV1 event while the stable operation and outcome remain

span and log attributes are projected through closed keep_keys allowlists, Prompt/provider raw response attributes are discarded, and the raw-content detector produces only a content-free incident signal
AccountRef and every other forbidden telemetry key fail the strict metric attribute Schema
trace_id is rejected as a Loki index label and retained only as non-index structured metadata
raw URL and query values never enter telemetry; a closed OpenAPI operation code is recorded instead
exception/parser text, SQL bind-like values and credentials are replaced by fixed reason and message codes
every metric has a declared closed label set and active-series limit; undeclared or unbounded labels fail the contract Gate
ordinary runtime cannot join Product Analytics or accept Safety/DataTask restricted details, and an isolation mutation fails with E013_PLANE_ISOLATION
an expected revision conflict is availability GOOD, latency EXCLUDED and remains independently countable as a command conflict
a fast service failure increments availability bad and is excluded from the success-latency denominator
the 1h and 5m windows must both exceed 14.4x before PAGE_HIGH and Alertmanager inhibits lower burn alerts for the same SLO
a high long window with a recovered short window returns NONE rather than paging
one low-traffic failure does not page without synthetic failure or five absolute failures
zero real traffic and host loss remain visible through absent-aware independent synthetic and telemetry heartbeat outage rules

T-E013-OBS-015.selector: separate synthetic dashboard and real burn expressions
assertions: synthetic success is displayed separately and cannot remove real-request bad events from burn calculations
an exhausted budget denies ordinary features while allowing the closed repair, rollback, Safety/Privacy, recovery and compliance classes
dynamic paths and query values collapse to UNKNOWN_HTTP or a fixed operation code without creating new series

T-E013-OBS-018.selector: minimum dependency and command metric registry
assertions: external exchange latency is represented by a separate operation metric family and is not merged into database command latency

T-E013-OBS-019.selector: PostgreSQL pool alert and database Runbook
assertions: 95 percent pool saturation or wait P95 above one second pages with the database Dashboard and Runbook
slow-query telemetry accepts only stable operation/reason buckets; SQL, bind values and exception messages fail the closed attribute Schema

T-E013-OBS-021.selector: Redis fault and PostgreSQL fact recovery
assertions: Redis loss is visible while PostgreSQL remains authoritative, stale personal cache is not restored and eligible state rebuilds from PostgreSQL
an unreadable breaker produces provider calls zero, controlled template continuation and a stable BREAKER_STATE_UNAVAILABLE reason
schema/grant fingerprint drift creates PAGE_CRITICAL and a release/profile readiness hard Gate
public health returns only stable status/reason envelopes without dependency, host, provider or version-catalog details

T-E013-OBS-025.selector: relay crash replay plus telemetry mapping
assertions: enqueue-before-PUBLISHED crash is replayable, duplicate delivery is observable and the transaction-scoped domain effect remains one
Interactive eligible age above 60 seconds pages with an async Runbook/release link and no job reference
Background lag is independently alerted and the API readiness contract is not coupled to Background or Restricted heartbeat
terminal contract failure stops blind retry, retry telemetry is bounded and the original opaque business key is unchanged
a disallowed profile job produces a hard capability rejection metric and never invokes the handler
total Redis loss rebuilds only eligible PostgreSQL facts within the bounded workflow and changes zero PostgreSQL fact counts
commit-before-ACK retry increments low-cardinality Inbox duplicate telemetry and produces one domain effect
queue payload fields and business content fail the queue/log contract and are never serialized by the telemetry sink
UNKNOWN usage/cost requires null, rejects zero and makes aggregate cost status BLOCKED
observed model mismatch makes the route inactive, provider calls zero and exposes only MODEL_MISMATCH for PAGE_CRITICAL
a stale price catalog permits zero provider calls, selects the controlled template and emits PRICE_CATALOG_STALE

T-E013-OBS-036.selector: generation availability and template-rate recording rules
assertions: template output can satisfy SLO-04 while the independent S25-M21 template ratio can fail; neither expression cancels the other
70 percent actual or forecast returns TICKET and keeps the reviewed provider route available
100 percent budget returns HARD_STOP, allows zero new provider calls and keeps template, Safety and deletion controls active
cost UNKNOWN above one percent or price coverage below 99 percent returns BLOCKED rather than a below-budget conclusion
per-user/account cost fields fail strict CostEntryV1 and only workload/provider revision aggregates are accepted
a raw-content match stops ordinary export, increments a content-free detector metric and creates PAGE_CRITICAL/IR-SEV0 candidate routing
75 percent DataTask deadline pages by aggregate scope/stage/outcome without task or user reference and preserves the guard

T-E013-OBS-043.selector: deletion and restore hard detector alert
assertions: one deletion guard, restore-deny or deleted-data detector failure pages immediately without an error budget
a 10-minute WAL gap pages high and a 15-minute gap becomes PAGE_CRITICAL plus Release Gate/incident candidate

T-E013-OBS-045.selector: backup expiry hard alert and lifecycle Runbook
assertions: a backup expiry violation creates a lifecycle incident candidate and the Runbook forbids using the expired backup as a recovery source
15 minutes of stale heartbeat, a missing heartbeat series, or exporter failure creates PAGE_HIGH and the Runbook explicitly forbids compensating with body logging
observability cost pressure pages and the Runbook reduces normal-success sampling/query retention before preserving hard detectors, SLO metrics and security logs
the exercise contract permits only conditional Phase 2 development admission while Production/RC remains NO_GO/completed=false; a false Production PASS or unconditional development GO is rejected
